justification: Standard: adds a printable page, one thin proxy route and a link, all reading the evidence endpoint merged in #1656. Not Minor: it is a new served page that prints law wording and results. Not Critical: it adds no regulatory number and no query, and every value shown is copied from the endpoint.

pre_impl.existing_data: GET /pipeline/housing-sepp/evidence (#1656) returns 13 exclusion rows, the walk range, 6 council controls and 4 council files for 2 Hand Avenue Penrith.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The main checkout's node_modules lacks jest, so tests were run from a fresh npm ci in this worktree.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: AreaCheckCard already shows the area check inside Site Facts; no page prints the law wording, council controls and files held. The proxy is copied from the area-check proxy (same no-store and error pass-through).
pre_impl.external_source_error: If the Python service or the evidence data fails, the proxy returns 502 and the page shows an error line, never an empty statement.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: A partial payload renders as an empty statement, an unreadable source renders as empty, a bad coordinate calls the service, or the proxy lets Next cache the answer.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Not run red first; the checks were written with the code and cover the break-it list below.
falsifiable_check.observed_green: 10 tests pass across 3 files, and the existing components/compliance tests still pass.

functions.name: isEvidence
functions.output: true only when every part the page reads is present with a known status
functions.if_none: null or a partial payload gives false and the page shows an error line

functions.name: evidenceUrl
functions.input: lat and lng text from the address bar
functions.if_none: a missing or non-numeric coordinate gives null and nothing is fetched

functions.name: GET
functions.if_none: non-numeric input gives 400; a service failure gives 502

values.value: every result, clause, page and council wording on the page
values.read_at: the evidence endpoint JSON, shown unchanged
values.if_missing: shown as not given or not recorded, never filled in

break_it.scenario: The Python service returns a partial or error body.
break_it.what_happens: The page would print an empty statement that reads like nothing was found.
break_it.how: isEvidence rejects it and the page shows an alert line; the proxy turns a service error into 502.

break_it.scenario: The council file ledger or controls database did not answer.
break_it.what_happens: The section would read as no files or no controls.
break_it.how: Each source carries its own status; unreadable prints the reason, none prints that none are held.

break_it.scenario: The address bar has no coordinates or a non-number.
break_it.what_happens: The service would be called with a bad point.
break_it.how: evidenceUrl returns null, the page asks for coordinates and calls nothing; the proxy also returns 400.

break_it.what_happens: An old law text would keep printing after the law file changes.
break_it.how: The proxy fetches with cache no-store and the route is force-dynamic.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open /reports/evidence-statement?lat=-33.758709788282516&lng=150.70039310488076 on the deployed app and check 13 exclusion rows and the print preview.
